question: Which team won the most games in 2001? Give the team name and wins.
gold_sql: SELECT name, W FROM Teams WHERE yearID = 2001 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many players were born in Japan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM People WHERE birthCountry = 'Japan'

question: What was the highest salary last season?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Salaries WHERE yearID = (SELECT MAX(yearID) FROM Salaries)

question: Which franchise has the most all-time wins? Give the franchise ID and total wins.
gold_sql: SELECT franchID, SUM(W) AS wins FROM Teams GROUP BY franchID ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total home attendance of the Boston Red Sox in 2019?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(attendance) FROM HomeGames WHERE yearkey = 2019 AND teamkey = 'BOS'

question: How many home runs did Mark McGwire hit in 1997?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(b.HR) FROM Batting b JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE p.nameFirst = 'Mark' AND p.nameLast = 'McGwire' AND b.yearID = 1997

question: Who hit the most home runs in 1997? Give first name, last name and home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS hr FROM Batting b JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE b.yearID = 1997 GROUP BY b.playerID ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each player named Chris Young, give the playerID and career home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.playerID, SUM(b.HR) FROM People p JOIN Batting b ON p.playerID = b.playerID WHERE p.nameFirst = 'Chris' AND p.nameLast = 'Young' GROUP BY p.playerID

question: Which franchise has hit the most home runs all-time? Give the franchise name and total home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT f.franchName, SUM(t.HR) AS hr FROM Teams t JOIN TeamsFranchises f ON t.franchID = f.franchID GROUP BY t.franchID ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who led MLB in home runs last season? Give first name, last name and home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS hr FROM Batting b JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE b.yearID = (SELECT MAX(yearID) FROM Batting) GROUP BY b.playerID ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which team had the highest total payroll in 2016? Give the team name and payroll.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, SUM(s.salary) AS payroll FROM Salaries s JOIN Teams t ON s.teamID = t.teamID AND s.yearID = t.yearID WHERE s.yearID = 2016 GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY payroll DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first and last names of players who hit 40 or more home runs in 2001 and were All-Stars that year.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast FROM (SELECT playerID, SUM(HR) AS hr FROM Batting WHERE yearID = 2001 GROUP BY playerID HAVING SUM(HR) >= 40) b JOIN AllstarFull a ON a.playerID = b.playerID AND a.yearID = 2001 JOIN People p ON p.playerID = b.playerID

question: How many different players have played for the Los Angeles Dodgers franchise, including its Brooklyn years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.playerID) FROM Batting b JOIN Teams t ON b.teamID = t.teamID AND b.yearID = t.yearID JOIN TeamsFranchises f ON t.franchID = f.franchID WHERE f.franchName = 'Los Angeles Dodgers'

question: Who was the highest-paid New York Yankees player in the most recent season with salary data? Give first name, last name and salary.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, s.salary FROM Salaries s JOIN People p ON s.playerID = p.playerID JOIN Teams t ON s.teamID = t.teamID AND s.yearID = t.yearID WHERE t.name = 'New York Yankees' AND s.yearID = (SELECT MAX(yearID) FROM Salaries) ORDER BY s.salary DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which Hall of Fame inducted player has the most career home runs? Give first name, last name and home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS hr FROM HallOfFame h JOIN People p ON h.playerID = p.playerID JOIN Batting b ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE h.inducted = 'Y' AND h.category = 'Player' GROUP BY p.playerID ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first and last names of players who attended the University of Southern California and hit at least 100 career home runs, with their career home runs.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS hr FROM Schools s JOIN CollegePlaying c ON s.schoolID = c.schoolID JOIN People p ON c.playerID = p.playerID JOIN Batting b ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE s.name_full = 'University of Southern California' GROUP BY p.playerID HAVING SUM(b.HR) >= 100

question: For the 2001 Seattle Mariners, list each player's first name, last name, home runs for Seattle and salary, for the top 5 salaries.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.HR) AS hr, s.salary FROM Salaries s JOIN Teams t ON s.teamID = t.teamID AND s.yearID = t.yearID JOIN People p ON s.playerID = p.playerID JOIN Batting b ON b.playerID = s.playerID AND b.yearID = s.yearID AND b.teamID = s.teamID WHERE t.name = 'Seattle Mariners' AND s.yearID = 2001 GROUP BY s.playerID ORDER BY s.salary DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many pitches did Clayton Kershaw throw in his last start?
What was Aaron Judge's batting average with runners in scoring position in 2025?
How many home runs has Shohei Ohtani hit so far in the 2026 season?
Who stole the most bases in 2011? Give first name, last name and stolen bases.
gold_sql: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.SB) AS sb FROM Batting b JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE b.yearID = 2011 GROUP BY b.playerID ORDER BY sb DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many walks did Adam Dunn draw in 2008?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(b.BB) FROM Batting b JOIN People p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE p.nameFirst = 'Adam' AND p.nameLast = 'Dunn' AND b.yearID = 2008

question: How many total wins does the Atlanta Braves franchise have all-time?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(t.W) FROM Teams t JOIN TeamsFranchises f ON t.franchID = f.franchID WHERE f.franchName = 'Atlanta Braves'

question: How many league pennants has the Los Angeles Dodgers franchise won in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Teams t JOIN TeamsFranchises f ON t.franchID = f.franchID WHERE f.franchName = 'Los Angeles Dodgers' AND t.LgWin = 'Y'

question: How many wins did the 1927 New York Yankees have?
gold_sql: SELECT W FROM Teams WHERE yearID = 1927 AND name = 'New York Yankees'

question: How many films are rated PG-13?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

question: How many films are in the Horror category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: How many films has Penelope Guiness appeared in?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: For each actor named Susan Davis, give the actor ID and the number of films they appeared in.
gold_sql: SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(*) FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'SUSAN' AND a.last_name = 'DAVIS' GROUP BY a.actor_id

question: What was the total payment revenue in June 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2005-06-01' AND payment_date < '2005-07-01'

question: Which customer has paid the most in total? Give first name, last name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many rental customers live in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: Which film category has been rented the most? Give the category name and the number of rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average customer review score for films?
How many products are discontinued?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = '1'

question: How many orders were shipped to the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE ShipCountry = 'UK'

question: What is the most expensive product and which category is it in? Give the product name and category name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.ProductName, c.CategoryName FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID ORDER BY p.UnitPrice DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units are in stock across all products supplied by Pavlova, Ltd.?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(p.UnitsInStock) FROM Products p JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID WHERE s.CompanyName = 'Pavlova, Ltd.'

question: Which employee has handled the most orders? Give first name, last name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders did customers from Germany place?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

question: What was the total revenue in 2016, after discounts?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(d.UnitPrice * d.Quantity * (1 - d.Discount)), 2) FROM "Order Details" d JOIN Orders o ON d.OrderID = o.OrderID WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2017-01-01'

question: Which product category had the highest revenue in 2016, after discounts? Give the category name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, ROUND(SUM(d.UnitPrice * d.Quantity * (1 - d.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" d JOIN Orders o ON d.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON d.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
